record.one_liner: GitHub developer platform with REST and GraphQL APIs for integrations to retrieve data and automate workflows.
record.auth_notes: Personal access tokens (api_key). OAuth tokens via OAuth apps or GitHub Apps user access tokens (oauth2). GitHub Apps also use installation tokens from a private key JWT and client ID/secret pairs for some endpoints (other). critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: PATs and app creation are self-serve; GitHub pricing page lists a Free plan at $0. critic: confirmed self_serve_free, free plan verified on pricing page.
record.api_notes: REST API for integrations, data retrieval and automation; critic: api_style rest -> rest+graphql, vendor docs document a GitHub GraphQL API as well.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve PAT and GitHub App credentials with documented public API on a free plan. critic: confirmed ready.
